system.description: Risky. You catch a foe's weapon, claw or arm and spin with it. Test Agility (DR16) against a foe within reach. On a success, its weapon flies 10' away or its limb is wrenched aside: creatures defend against its attacks with Boon until the end of its next turn.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until the foe spends an action to recover, and a dropped weapon lands in your free hand if you have one.
outcomes.failure: Creatures defend against its next attack with Boon.
outcomes.ruin: It wrenches back: the Dark Master chooses whether you drop the weapon you hold or the foe makes a melee attack against you at once.
